title: Deep-time skip menu + presentation LOD (C-024 / C-025)
simLoop: Discrete skip presets advance exact sim-minute spans starting the band ladder at a bound integration floor (event→decadal). Skip actions append to a sparse schedule on SaveDocument (schema v13). Compressed annual/decadal periods stay Locked under C-024; L6 continuous rates are unchanged.
gameLoop: Player picks Skip 1 day … 1000 years beside the L6 rate ladder, gets one bounded jump at a named floor, then resumes inhabiting at the current rate. Under hitch or fast rates, presentation LOD sheds streaks/sway/cloud spin while water, terrain, and snow-hold stay truthful — so time controls no longer change how precip is drawn.
notebookSeed: Ask for a century, get a century — then you are back in the place, watching what the jump left behind.
tierO: Owner question (batch later): does a 1000-year cold skip still feel like the same place, only coarser? Machine half does not wait.
